cw721_address.description: Existing CW721 (e.g. cw721-svg) address where this minter is authorized. If None, admin must call `LinkCollection` before mint.

max_tokens.description: Hard supply cap. Oracle/sudo can NEVER increase this.

proceeds.description: Address that receives mint proceeds (defaults to owner).

token_uri_prefix.description: Base token URI / template prefix (collection-specific; optional).

algo.description: Optional filter: only accept sudo for this algo.

asset_id.description: Optional asset filter when decoding JSON price payloads (`asset` field).

bps_band.description: Half-width band in basis points around mid. 0 = exact mid only. Payment must satisfy mid * (1 - bps/10000) ..= mid * (1 + bps/10000).

chain_uid.description: Optional filter: only accept sudo for this chain_uid.

fallback_unit_price.description: When oracle disabled or mid absent: fixed unit price in `denom` microunits.

max_staleness_seconds.description: Fail closed when mid is older than this many seconds (vs `env.block.time`).

usd_to_unit_scale.description: If attestation has `price_usd` (decimal string) and no direct mid, mid = round(price_usd * usd_to_unit_scale). Demo FX only.

PriceSyncMode.description: How the minter obtains price mids.

oneOf.description: Mode A: x/hashmerchant sudo push (preferred long-term).
Mode B: pull/query another store (stub for frameworks; not required in v0 minter).
Mode C: admin ExecuteMsg sync (demo fallback only).

WhitelistConfig.description: Config snapshot for a minter that gates on loyalty eligibility.

root.description: 32-byte merkle root as lowercase hex (empty if not set).
